name: Consumer Cellular (Partner)
desc:
Remote Inbound Sales Representative (Oklahoma City area, req 260874) | $17/hr base + uncapped commission | Inbound, sales heavy, quotas and metrics expected
Company: Consumer Cellular
Industry: Customer Service

What a typical day will look like:
You take inbound calls from people who are shopping for wireless plans and phones. You ask discovery questions to learn what they need and what they can spend, then recommend a plan that fits. When a customer pushes back, you answer their concerns and explain why Consumer Cellular is a good value. Then you close the sale and welcome them to the family. You log everything accurately in CXOne and other internal tools, and you are measured on sales and metrics. Consumer Cellular says people come for the price and stay for the experience, so the way you treat callers matters as much as the sale.

Soft Skills
- Active listening
- Asking good questions
- Staying calm and positive when a customer says no
- Confidence closing a sale
- Teamwork and a self-starter attitude
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements

Education Minimum: Not listed in the posting.
Required Experience: At least 1 year of sales experience (inbound, outbound, or retail), including closing sales and meeting metrics and quotas.
Preferred Experience: Not listed.
Required Skills:
- Strong communication and active listening
- Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)
- Comfortable on a PC and web browsers
- Thinking on your feet, asking the right questions, and closing sales
- Self-starter who wants to grow with the company
- Must live within 50 miles of the Oklahoma City center, even though the role is remote

This role is ideal for someone who:
- Has at least a year of sales experience, even in retail
- Likes talking with people and enjoys the challenge of a close
- Wants to earn more through uncapped commission
- Lives within 50 miles of Oklahoma City

Not a Good Fit for someone who:
- Has no sales experience
- Does not want a role with sales goals and quotas
- Wants a steady hourly paycheck with no commission pressure
- Lives more than 50 miles from Oklahoma City
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
1. Submit application
2. Expect an assessment at the end of the application or emailed directly to you
3. If the assessment is passing, watch for an email or text from a recruiter for a phone screen
4. If the phone screen goes well, expect a final interview
This is an estimated process. Total time to hire from date of application can be anywhere from 3 to 15 days on average. Consumer Cellular says every application is reviewed by a real person on their Talent Acquisition team.

Top 10 resume keywords:
- Inbound sales
- Consultative selling
- Discovery questions
- Closing sales
- Overcoming objections
- Meeting quotas and metrics
- Customer experience
- Active listening
- CRM and call software
- Microsoft Office

4-5 Interview Questions for this Role:
- Tell me about your sales experience and what you enjoyed most about it.
- How do you find out what a customer really needs before you recommend something?
- Tell me about a time you hit a sales goal or quota. (PAR: Problem, Action, Result)
- Tell me about a time a customer said no and you turned the conversation around. (PAR: Problem, Action, Result)
- How do you stay positive and motivated when you have a slow day on commission?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:

-Pay: $17/hr base plus uncapped commission.

-Shift: Must have availability for any shift based on business needs. Can be discussed in final interview, offer stage.

-Benefits: Basic benefits: insurance options, PTO, possible 401k. The posting does not list specific benefits, so confirm with the recruiter.

-Equipment Provided: Not stated in this posting. Confirm with the recruiter.

-Felony Friendly? Not stated. Pre-employment background check required.

-Drug Test: Required. Pre-employment drug screen. Confirm the OMMA policy directly.

-Notes: This role is remote, but you must live within 50 miles of the Oklahoma City center, so it fits OKC-area participants only. The posting says there is also an on-site seat if you prefer to work in the center. Training is described as comprehensive with ongoing support, but the length is not listed. This is a sales role with commission, so expect sales goals and metrics. Consumer Cellular says all official recruiting messages come from an @consumercellular.com email address or their verified texting platform, which is only used to schedule interviews, so watch for lookalike scam messages. They will never ask for personal or financial information during recruiting. The posting does not list a closing date.

-Career Pathway: Reasonable inferred path: Inbound Sales Representative → Senior Sales Representative → Team Lead → Sales or Customer Care Supervisor. The posting says they promote from within.
